verses.text: Make no great account who is for thee or against thee, but mind only the present duty and take care that God be with thee in whatsoever thou doest.
verses.modernizedText: Make no great account of who is for you or against you, but attend only to your present duty and take care that God is with you in whatever you do.

verses.text: Have a good conscience and God will defend thee, for he whom God will help no man’s perverseness shall be able to hurt.
verses.modernizedText: Have a good conscience and God will defend you, for no person’s perverseness can hurt the one whom God will help.

verses.text: If thou knowest how to hold thy peace and to suffer, without doubt thou shalt see the help of the Lord.
verses.modernizedText: If you know how to hold your peace and suffer, without doubt you will see the help of the Lord.

verses.text: He knoweth the time and the way to deliver thee, therefore must thou resign thyself to Him.
verses.modernizedText: He knows the time and the way to deliver you; therefore you must resign yourself to Him.

verses.text: To God it belongeth to help and to deliver from all confusion.
verses.modernizedText: It belongs to God to help and to deliver from all confusion.

verses.text: Oftentimes it is very profitable for keeping us in greater humility, that others know and rebuke our faults.
verses.modernizedText: Often it is very profitable for keeping us in greater humility that others know and rebuke our faults.

verses.text: When a man humbleth himself for his defects, he then easily pacifieth others and quickly satisfieth those that are angered against him.
verses.modernizedText: When a person humbles himself for his defects, he easily pacifies others and quickly satisfies those who are angry with him.

verses.text: God protecteth and delivereth the humble man, He loveth and comforteth the humble man, to the humble man He inclineth Himself, on the humble He bestoweth great grace, and when he is cast down He raiseth him to glory: to the humble He revealeth His secrets, and sweetly draweth and inviteth him to Himself.
verses.modernizedText: God protects and delivers the humble person; He loves and comforts the humble, inclines Himself to them, and bestows great grace on them; and when they are cast down He raises them to glory. To the humble He reveals His secrets, and sweetly draws and invites them to Himself.

verses.text: The humble man having received reproach, is yet in sufficient peace, because he resteth on God and not on the world.
verses.modernizedText: The humble person, having received reproach, is still sufficiently at peace because he rests on God and not on the world.

verses.text: Reckon not thyself to have profited in anywise unless thou feel thyself to be inferior to all.
verses.modernizedText: Do not consider that you have profited in any way unless you feel yourself to be inferior to all.
